description: IQAir AirVisual API provides real-time and historical air quality index (AQI), pollutant concentrations, and weather data from a global network of monitoring stations and satellite sources. Developers can query by city, nearest station, or geographic coordinates for applications that need pollution alerts, environmental dashboards, or health-related location insights.
